preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]) and all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::3])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains two integers N and K (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5, 0 ≤ K ≤ 10^9), and the next two lines contain N integers each for arrays A and B.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= abs(int(x)) <= 10**5 for x in ' '.join(stdin.splitlines()[2::3]).split()) and all(0 <= abs(int(x)) <= 10**5 for x in ' '.join(stdin.splitlines()[3::3]).split())
preconditions.description: Each element in arrays A and B satisfies 0 ≤ |A[i]|, |B[i]| ≤ 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.split()) == T for stdout in [stdout.strip() for stdout in stdin.split('\n\n')])
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T integers, one per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.split()[i] == str(max(sum(A[j] * B[j] for j in range(N)) + sum(abs(B[j]) * min(K_remaining, abs(A[j] - target[j])) for j in range(N)), key=lambda x: x)) for i, (N, K, A, B) in enumerate(zip(Ns, Ks, As, Bs)) if (K_remaining := K) >= 0 and (target := [A[j] + (B[j] > 0) * K_remaining - (B[j] < 0) * K_remaining for j in range(N)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the maximum possible interaction value (sum of A[i] * B[i]) after performing at most K operations, where each operation changes an element of A by ±1. The optimal strategy is to adjust each A[i] toward the sign of B[i] (if B[i] > 0, increase A[i]; if B[i] < 0, decrease A[i]) until K operations are exhausted.
